ww.name: Ukwelashwa kwamanzi
ww.lede: Lungisa isitshalo se-activated sludge (imodeli ye-ASM1 eshicilelwe) noma sebenzisa izibalo zokwakha, bese ubeka ngayinye indawo yokugeleza esitebeni ngokusuka evolumini nasejuqulweni lamanzi. Ingxenye yokufunda, hhayi ukuvunywa kwezobunjiniyela: amakhonstanti e-ASM1 afakwe ngesandla futhi awakahlolwa yinjiniyela.
ww.placed: Beka imiphetho yamabhesini: {n} esitebeni njengemigqa yesici (ukuhlehlisa kunyathelo olulodwa). Izikwele ezibambela indawo: isimo nendawo kungakho.
ww.norun: Qala kuqala isibali se-activated sludge: akukho mabhesini okubeka.
ww.engine.held: ayikatholakali okwamanje: ilayisense yayo ilinde umnikazi, futhi ayikho iskripthi esilethwa kuyo.
ww.engine.ok: ingasebenza nge-CadCraft Studio uma isifakiwe kule khompyutha.
calc.lede: Khetha isibali, uhlele isampula yokufaka, bese usisebenzisa. Yisisiza sokubala, hhayi ukuvunyelwa kwezobunjiniyela: izinhlamvu ezibhaliwe zimakwe ukuze zibuyekezwe.
